-- RAW-FINGERPRINT: 38939ca0-44e0-4493-998c-85d1221deea8
-- Lua Luau compatible loader
local fingerprint = "38939ca0-44e0-4493-998c-85d1221deea8"
local payload = ""
local keyHex = "4b0b5919887f752e6897ab55125d03ed"

local key = {}
for i = 1, #keyHex, 2 do
    key[#key + 1] = tonumber(keyHex:sub(i, i + 1), 16)
end

local output = {}
for i = 1, #payload, 2 do
    local index = math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
    local value = tonumber(payload:sub(i, i + 1), 16)
    local k = key[(index % #key) + 1]

    output[#output + 1] = string.char(
        (value - k - (index % 251)) % 256
    )
end

local source = table.concat(output)
local compiler = loadstring
assert(type(compiler) == "function",
    "loadstring tidak tersedia di executor")

local chunk, err = compiler(source)
assert(chunk, "Gagal compile payload: " .. tostring(err))
return chunk()
